Q16086292.descEn: The memorial complex on Ljubić hill near Čačak commemorates the Battle of Ljubić in 1815, the largest engagement of the Second Serbian Uprising. The monument was put up in 1938 and is dedicated to the fighters and events of Serbia’s wars of liberation in the 19th and 20th centuries.
